sections.title: Read Rating start and rise
sections.what: Checks a new user's rating starts at 1200 with a provisional label, rises after two good calls, and shows a history chart with the expected description.
sections.why: Confirms the rating starts fairly, responds to good calls, and is never presented as final.
sections.watch_out: The rise check assumes best picks grade as correct, so a grading change will fail the test.

summary: Browser test of the Read Rating: starts at 1200 with a provisional badge, rises after two correct best picks, and shows a history chart.
purpose: Confirms the user's rating starts correctly, moves in the right direction after good calls, and is labelled provisional.
why: Ratings can be misread as final, so the provisional label must show, and the rating must respond to correct calls.
how: It creates a user, opens the notebook, and checks the rating shows 1200 after zero graded calls with a provisional label. It then locks two calls using the best option at high confidence, reloads, and checks the rating is above 1200 with two graded calls. It checks the history chart is present with its description and one line, and that the provisional label appears at least twice.
inputs: A new user, two fixture moments, and the notebook page.
outputs: Pass or fail for starting value, direction, chart and labels.
risks: The test assumes the best picks are scored as correct; a change to grading could change the outcome.
debug: If the rating does not rise, check the grading of graded calls. If the label is missing, check the provisional marker.
